newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close up, US to set next week's pace.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close up, US to set next week's pace.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher in a positive if rather lethargic bond-focused market on Friday, with dealers foreseeing that U.S. developments would determine the way things go next week.
"It has been a rather quiet day with the market pulled up by the positive bond market. Wall Street will set the agenda for Monday," one dealer said.
The top-20 KFX index closed 0.82 point up at 130.90, while the KFX December future rose 0.35 point to 130.95 with 152 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Focus was mainly on KFX paper Unidanmark, BG Bank and Carlsberg.
Unidanmark closed two crowns higher at 294 with 151,000 shares traded, while BG Bank climbed 11 crowns to finish at a year high of 261 and Den Danske Bank ended unchanged at 443.
Carlsberg, bolstered by a Goldman Sachs upgrading to market performer from market underperformer, put on six crowns to close at 385.
